facts.text: SAMPLE: Rome had almost no navy when it first fought Carthage, so it built whole fleets and fought sea battles like land battles.
SAMPLE: In 1674 Shivaji was crowned at Raigad fort and took the title Chhatrapati.
SAMPLE: Chanakya's circle-of-states idea says your neighbour is a likely rival and your neighbour's neighbour a likely friend.
SAMPLE: Crossing the small river Rubicon with his army made Julius Caesar a traitor in 49 BCE. He won the war that followed.
SAMPLE: Shivaji built a navy and sea forts at a time when most land powers in India paid little attention to the sea.
SAMPLE: The Arthashastra, linked to Chanakya, covers taxes, spies, law and war in one practical guide to running a state.
